'''Jason Robinette''' was the [[Players Committee]] [[Marketing Advocate]] from 2002 to 2008.<ref name="home2002" /><ref name="council2002" /> He was also a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 3 from New York City, NY. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He co-wrote [[Mirror, Mirror (InQuest)|Mirror, Mirror]] with [[Michael Mikaelian]] and wrote [[Jabba's Palace (InQuest)]] in ''[[InQuest]]'' #39 (July 1998).<ref name="wook-39">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 InQuest 39], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251112204442/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016121021/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Internet Archive]</ref>

[[File:Jason Robinette Times Square 1999.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Robinette in Times Square, New York, 1999]]

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
